text: During the three years this composer lived in the United States after World War I, he composed his Overture on Hebrew Themes. This composer mocked traditional harmonies in his group of five Sarcasms for piano. His first symphony was inspired by his time as the student of Alexander Tcherepnin, and unusually includes a third movement gavotte in homage to late-eighteenth century composers such as Joseph Haydn. Another of his works, a suite originally written as a score for an Alexander Faintsimmer film, features rhythmic sleigh bells in its fourth movement troika. This composer of the Classical Symphony and the Lieutenant Kije Suite also wrote a work for children in which an oboe represents the duck. For 10 points, name this Soviet composer of Peter and the Wolf.
